name: Unauthorized v2 RFC callback due to wrong certificate serial
description:
Test v2 RFC callback DS12N with wrong certificate identity.

Flow:
1. Activate payer
2. Send an RTP via GPD message v2 (CREATE VALID)
3. Cancel the RTP via GPD message v2 (DELETE) -> RTP to RFC_SENT
4. Send DS12N callback with assignee_bic='FAKESP01' (doesn't match certificate identity)
5. Verify callback is rejected with 403 (certificate mismatch)
6. Verify RTP status is still RFC_SENT
